notePath.description: The note's path relative to the knowledge root, as reported by note.list and note.search. Root-relative and Markdown only; the knowledge service additionally resolves the path and refuses anything landing outside the root, so this pattern is a first gate, not the boundary. Named `notePath` rather than `path` because the code generator derives type names from property names, and a schema structurally identical to note-read-input would otherwise collapse into one shared type.
